# nof1.ai-alpha-arena (Reference)

Place your fork of `nof1.ai-alpha-arena` here as a submodule for strategy research and provenance.

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/<GITHUB_OWNER>/nof1.ai-alpha-arena-upstream.git vendor/nof1.ai-alpha-arena
```

Do not run upstream binary releases; consume source only. Preserve the upstream LICENSE file.
